title: WebView TLS error bypass
remediation: Cancel TLS errors. Validate the server certificate through the platform trust implementation.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: Substring host validation near WebView or deep-link code
remediation: Parse the URL and validate scheme and exact host, including a dot-boundary check for approved subdomains. Add runtime link cases.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: JavaScript-to-native bridge requires origin review
remediation: Review loaded origins and exposed methods. Verify that untrusted content cannot invoke privileged native operations.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: WebView file-origin access enabled
remediation: Disable file-origin cross-origin access; use WebViewAssetLoader for local content.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: Potential sensitive data in logs
remediation: Remove or redact sensitive values and verify with a unique test canary in a release-equivalent test build.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: Potential credential in ordinary preferences
remediation: Review the data sensitivity and use platform-backed secure storage where required. Verify logout invalidation and deletion policy.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: Broad Keychain accessibility policy
remediation: Choose a Keychain accessibility class that fits the app's locked-device and migration requirements.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: Non-cryptographic random value assigned to a security-named variable
remediation: Use java.security.SecureRandom (or a platform key generator) for tokens, nonces, salts and passwords.
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step

title: X509TrustManager accepts every server certificate
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step
remediation: Use the platform default TrustManager, or pin with Network Security Configuration; never accept unchecked chains.

title: Hostname verification accepts every host
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step
remediation: Keep the default hostname verification; do not replace it with a verifier that returns true.

title: Data is written to external or shared storage
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step
remediation: Keep sensitive data in internal app storage or encrypt it; shared storage is readable by other apps and the user.

title: Java object deserialization with ObjectInputStream
mapping_scope: partial: related OWASP test, not a complete implementation of every test step
remediation: Do not deserialize untrusted data with ObjectInputStream; use a data format with explicit schemas and validate input.
